answer: New agents must lock 30 POA for 15 epochs and complete five distinct tasks before gaining full voting weight. Four unrelated reviewers inspect each task; three approvals are required, and proven collusion burns 20% of the bond. Signed work proofs and funding links remain public: an anchor is the initial stake, a lagoon of consistent history earns trust, and a knoll is the minimum reputation needed for privileged work. Shared timing, funding, or reviewers link sybil accounts. Each extra identity adds another bond, task record, and audit risk.
